title: sign.rs: wrap_base64 builds intermediate Vec before joining — stream instead
description: sign.rs:368-376: wrap_base64 builds a Vec<&str> then calls .join('\r\n'). This allocates the Vec and then re-allocates for the joined String. Idiomatic alternative: pre-calculate capacity (b64.len() + (b64.len()/width)*2) and write chunks directly into a String using a fold or for loop with push_str. The current form reads clearly but models the pattern of collecting then joining rather than streaming — a pattern contributors will repeat.
